name: ADHD UK
description: A UK charity run by people with ADHD that provides ADHD information, diagnosis-pathway guidance, support groups and practical resources.
intended_use: Find UK-focused ADHD information, peer-support routes and explanations of diagnosis and care pathways.
audience_or_context: People with ADHD, people exploring whether ADHD may be relevant to them, families and others looking for UK-specific information or community support.
limitations: ADHD UK is not an emergency or urgent mental-health service.
It is not itself a diagnostic provider or a Right to Choose provider; current NHS and provider routes should be checked independently.
Support-group availability and service details can change.
cost_or_access_notes: Much of the information and community material is available online; individual activities or third-party services may have separate costs.
conflicts_of_interest: The charity describes and fundraises for its own work; its first-party material is not automatically independent evidence for clinical or product claims.

provenance.method: Official organisation, support and contact information checked on 2026-08-28. Listing records identity, scope and access without treating organisational authority as evidence for unrelated claims.
